thread:
nora: Heads up 1: we got a customer bug where long streaming requests under heavy ingress hedging ended up with interleaved tokens from two backends. Repro attached.

nora: Steps: client starts stream, gateway hedges to backup when primary slows, backup starts from 0 (no KV snapshot) and begins emitting; client observes A:1..900 then A:1..300 interleaved.

ryan: We definitely saw memory spikes too. Replay doubles in-flight token buffering and occasionally OOMs on the edge.

claire: Is this only for models that rely on a KV cache? or for all streaming?

nora: Mostly KV-dependent decoders, but we saw a similar misalignment once with a non-kv long context model on a cold replica.

sam: Root cause theory: hedged replica gets a fresh runtime with empty KV and runtime replays prefix to catch up. There's no resume token handshake so proxy just retries blindly.

lina: Proposal: require streams to opt into resumability. Add header x-rw-resumable: 1 and a resume-token header x-rw-resume-token that encodes the last accepted token index + kv snapshot id. Upstream will validate token and ack via trailer x-rw-resume-accepted: true/false.

ryan: If resume rejected we must NOT replay. Instead failfast and return a Retry-After or 409 with a retry hint. Otherwise we double-charge and double-buffer.

claire: SDK impact: need clear guidance. Default behavior should remain unchanged for apps that don't opt-in. Make resumable opt-in per-client and per-route in Console.

nora: Observability: add metrics stream.resume_attempts, stream.resume_rejections, stream.replay_memory_amplification. Trace sampling should include upstream ids + truncated token.

sam: Billing: dedupe by resume-token on the billing pipeline for the dedupe window. Also track tokens accounted vs delivered to avoid double-billing on partial replays.

devbot: rollout plan: behind FF, default off. Canary 5% first day, 25% next week if stable. Add a stress test harness that exercises hedging + resume across many small and large streams.

r yan: Action items: (1) nora spec of header/trailer + policy; (2) ryan implement per-request inflight token cap; (3) claire update SDK/docs; (4) sam ensure billing dedupe; (5) devops add stress test.

nora: I'll write up a short RFC follow-up capturing tradeoffs: opt-in safety, memory protection, and billing dedupe. Thanks all.

sam: SGTM. :thumbsup:

claire: I'll draft SDK examples and a migration note.

nora: ping me if you need clarifications.
